data.name: Axie Infinity
data.description: Axie Infinity is a digital game that fuses NFT collectibles and blockchain. The game allows users to discover, collect, combine, and battle fantasy creatures called Axies.

methodology.Fees: All fees paid axie infinity users trading on marketplace and other in-game activities.
methodology.Revenue: Fees collected by the protocol post creator fee reduction.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All the revenue goes to protocol treasury

Fees.Protocol Fees: Marketplace fees (4.25%) collected by the protocol treasury from NFT trades on Axie marketplace and in-game activities
Fees.Creator Fees: Creator royalty fees (1%) paid to NFT creators from marketplace trades

Revenue.Protocol Fees: All marketplace fees retained by the protocol treasury after excluding creator royalties

ProtocolRevenue.Protocol Fees: All marketplace fees retained by the protocol treasury after excluding creator royalties
